column1: # Malformed-font fixtures (d.6, D-190): how each fixture is rebuilt from a committed base font.
# Columns: fixture <TAB> base font <TAB> operations, applied in order, separated by spaces:
#   truncate:N (keep the first N bytes); patch:offset:byte,... (decimal, in order); append:hex (bytes added at the end).
# The M3 round variants are rebuilt from M3-corrupt-layout-patches.tsv (as received). Every rebuilt file is checked
# against SHA256.tsv (as received) where it has an entry.
